Hi Jared —

Thanks for the heads up and for the usage file. Good problem to have. Short answers up front: yes, we can support a mid-contract reserved top-up and co-term it to your renewal. There are two pragmatic options depending on how ClearVista wants to balance cost vs flexibility: 

1) Committed top-up (recommended if you expect sustained increase)
   - Add 200k reserved units, co-term to 2027-04-01.
   - Discount: 12% off hosted list for the incremental committed units for the remainder of the term.
   - Billing: one pro-rated invoice now for the period until 2027-04-01 (prorated months), then annualizes at renewal.
   - SLA: unchanged; no impact to existing SLA.

2) Burst buffer + PAYG overflow (if spike may be temporary)
   - Keep current commitment; add a burst buffer for 6 months (soft cap) and route overflow to PAYG.
   - No upfront commit discount; PAYG rates apply to overflow tokens.
   - Billing: PAYG shows on monthly invoice.

I'll loop Marissa and Aditya for approvals and to confirm pricing and invoicing mechanics. If you want, we can draft an amendment (SOW) and get procurement a DocuSign link within 48 hours.

Would you like me to price the committed top-up both as a straight pro-rate and as a voucher-style credit (we sometimes do a small voucher split for shorter remaining terms)?

Regards,
David
